statement: Run 099-simulate shows inspection-1 is supply-limited rather than capacity-limited: the deep-metrology cell can process 16.87 jobs/min but ran at 20.7% utilization, while etch-to-inspection delivered 12 lots through a four-cell 0.9 s lane at 1.3% utilization with zero blocked item-ticks. Upstream, etch-l2 accumulated 29.456 s of eligible input starvation; its seven-cell raised lithography-to-etch-lithography-l2 handoff takes 1.2 s per lot and accounts for 5.7 s of transport-in-flight shortage states. The same etch-l2 source-waiting state overlaps 7.544 s of inspection starvation, so the physically distinct observation target is the upstream patterned-wafer handoff, not inspection capacity or its ordinary downstream lane.
